name: Store directory
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Store directory.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Heading level
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for heading level. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Introduction
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Footer link
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Footer link label
settings.how: Enter the footer link label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Show newsletter invitation button
settings.how: Turn on “Show newsletter invitation button” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Category
settings.how: Enter the category. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Title
settings.how: Enter the title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Description
settings.how: Write the description. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Status when no link is set
settings.how: Enter the status when no link is set. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Link label
settings.how: Enter the link label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Link
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.
